title: [BUG][Typescript SDK] `canUseTool` callback in the Claude Code SDK is not working
author: planger

top_comments.body: Another fix will be arriving soon where Claude Code will not hang when this occurs and instead will reject the tool call (not desirable, but we need this to be reliable across all SDK surfaces).
